title: Swiss voters reject initiative to preserve neutrality
summary: According to preliminary results published by the Federal Statistical Office, 68.6% of voters opposed the initiative, while 31.4% supported it. Voter turnout was 46.36%

title: FIDE General Assembly upholds suspension of Chess Federation of Russia
summary: Delegates rejected proposals from the chess federations of Armenia, Belarus, Cuba, and Nicaragua to reinstate Russia’s membership by a majority vote

title: Kazakh president dismisses defense minister over drills incident, appoints new one
summary: At the same time, Tokayev signed a decree appointing Aidos Myrzakhmetov, commander of the Special Operations Forces, as the new top defense official
